node.title: Re: Earth as a sphere
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: May I ask what you want to use this for? I think that'll play a big role in determining the "best" representation for your purposes. Based on your point 9, you might want to look into [wp://Geographic information system]s. For example, [https://www.qgis.org/|QGIS] is an open-source GIS software, I played around with it a while back. It has fairly tight bindings with Python, but I think it should be possible to bind Perl into it as well. There are probably modules in the [cpan://Geo::] namespace that could help.
